title: The open settings panel locks every setting; Cosmo owns only references and the prompt
description: Fabio 2026-10-04, live: with the panel open on Wan 3.0 t2v 720p 4s ($0.40), Cosmo sent ref2v with the finished clip as its own reference and the spend card quoted $1.90 (4 s + a 15 s reference ceiling). Also: a reference clip is priced by its real length, a ceiling says 'up to', and a No on the spend card hands the price back so Cosmo stops inventing one. Blocks the 2.0 cut (MPI-595).
